programme.title: Maddie + Triggs

programme.desc: [AD] Animated series. When Peter gives the Shrew some worms to entice him to Cotton-tail's birthday party, he accidentally puts everyone in danger.

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.desc: [AD] Tidbit practises so hard for his hiking badge that he gives himself blisters.

programme.title: Supertato

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: [AD] Bluey and Bingo spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Zog

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
